configuration.format: JSON-compatible YAML 1.2, consumed directly by run.py
configuration.estimand: Selected observed decision-row distribution; replace current action once and let future natural mechanisms continue at changed states. Associational standardized/AIPW diagnostic without identified causal recommendation.
configuration.result: Raw season-weighted final PA W from OBS, not normalized BCAI, no added transition reward
configuration.selection: Completed PA and final-event eligibility depend on future results, not pretreatment eligibility. Physical-record exclusions and measurement support also condition target. No general causal treatment effect claim.
configuration.policy_X_Z: X contains current actual pitcher/batter and nuisance context; Z is count (pitch) or count|zone|FB-NFB (swing). No fictitious all-zero average-player row.

feature_lineage.base: current prepitch count/context and same-PA strictly lagged pitch code/description/speed; current description only labels
feature_lineage.zone: INNER abs(x)<=17/24-.15 and normalized z in [.1,.9]; OUT abs(x)>17/24+.15 or z<-.1 or z>1.1; remaining BOUNDARY; invalid/missing MISSING

configuration.post_measurement: SWING current ball characteristics are hindsight proxies for perception. Nonpositive zone height and missing current ball measurements have no policy support. 2026 SWING withheld due no bridge.
configuration.unknown_categories: Training-only observed string dictionaries; each unknown centered categorical block contributes zero; unseen IDs never provide repertoire support by imputation
configuration.nuisance: Action-specific ridge outcome T learner (both player IDs per arm). Binary ridge propensity score, Platt-calibrated on separate training games; clipping final e to numerical epsilon only.
configuration.ridge_objective: sum(y-ybar-(X-Xbar)beta)^2 + alpha sum(beta^2); intercept unpenalized, all category slopes penalized; T learner uses action-specific training means
configuration.tuning: 5way train-game partition: fold0 calibration; fold1 tuning; folds2-4 initial fits. Select min clipped-score Brier for p and observed-arm MSE for mu separately; exact tie larger alpha. Final p fit folds1-4 then calibrate fold0. Final mu fit all training rows in arm. External alphas frozen, no tuning.
configuration.calibration: sigmoid(intercept+slope*ridge_score); slope>=0; penalty1e-6*slope^2; heldout 20% training games; no outer evaluation or inner score games
configuration.split: Sorted unique game IDs shuffled with NumPy default_rng seed then round-robin. outer seed; inner seed+1000+100*k; each inner nuisance seed+100+k; outer nuisance seed+2000+k; final inner seed+9000; final nuisance seed+9900; external seed+year and nuisance seed+year+100+k.
configuration.policy_class: Per-Z inner AIPW mean argmin for pitch / argmax for swing; exact tie chooses action0; unseen or unsupported policy cell fallback Bernoulli(.5). Learned policy is a candidate diagnostic, not recommended. Final whole-development policy uses separate 2fold OOF scores.
configuration.conservative: Identification and full-learning uncertainty gates fail at design; H(Z)=0 everywhere. Contribution Y on retained rows, not propensity-plugged policy. Zero gain is definitional, not proof of effectiveness.
configuration.support: Both-arm >=30 in nuisance training entity AND .05<=e<=.95; SWING additionally valid zone, speed, movement, current group. Apply identical mask to both arms and all policies.
configuration.threshold_rationale: Pre-external conservative feasibility conventions, not empirical natural boundaries. delta .01 is raw W/current decision; never imported OBS ±5/15.
grade_priority: If evaluated support/sample gates fail: NO_SUPPORT
If causal identification/realtime feasibility or full-learning uncertainty gate fails: UNCERTAIN
If CI includes0 or external eligible direction conflicts: UNCERTAIN
If all adjusted intervals exceed delta, fixed candidate gains>0 in both required external seasons, support sufficient and identification+full-learning uncertainty gates pass: RECOMMENDED
Otherwise supported direction with sign-adjusted interval excluding0: LEAN
configuration.unexecuted: No grade. Store evaluation_status and explicit reason (e.g. WITHHELD_MEASUREMENT_NONCOMPARABILITY); distinguish from empirical NO_SUPPORT.
configuration.uncertainty: Conditional fixed-OOF-score game-cluster ratio sandwich, t(G-1) individual95 and Bonferroni .05/1536 simultaneous envelope. Family upper bound covers 5 evaluable model-period runs, overall/count/swing cells and action/policy contrasts. Does not propagate nuisance/policy fitting or cross-game player dependence. Separate pitcher/batter clustering sensitivities. Full-refit game bootstrap stability planned8 per model, too few for95% inference; no promotion based on those.
sensitivity: trim .02,.05,.10 plus training repertoire, each target separate

external.prior_exposure: Already used BCAI/Ridge; not wholly unseen datasets
external.fixed_prediction: Frozen development nuisance only, own prediction metrics/calibration/known-unseen
external.OPE: 3fold external-game nuisance with frozen dev alphas; train-only external dictionaries/calibration; final development policy unchanged
external.known_unseen: Against final development pitcher/batter roster, not refit roster
external.2026_swing: WITHHELD in entirety; neither raw location transport nor location-free substitute used

configuration.joint: Not designed: identification, sequential information and external SWING evidence insufficient
